description: Matches a buyer's challenge to VertoDigital's offer and returns up to three structured lists: services (which service fits, how it works, and a headline client result), proof_points (flagship case studies with headline stats and links) and differentiators (reasons clients choose VertoDigital, each backed by a fact). Use it to answer "can VertoDigital help with X" or "why VertoDigital"; to browse the full case-study library rather than the curated flagships, use vertodigital_search_case_studies. Matching runs against a curated keyword list inside the server, not the live site, so it is instant and deterministic. A full sentence works as a query, since an item matches when one of its keywords appears in it; a query that matches nothing returns empty lists rather than an error, so retry with a broader term such as "attribution". aspect limits the response to one list.

aspect.description: Narrow the response to one category: "services" (which VertoDigital service fits this challenge), "proof_points" (flagship case study stats), or "differentiators" (why clients choose VertoDigital). Omit to return all three.

query.description: Plain-language challenge, topic, industry, or client name to filter by. Examples: "we can't attribute our ad spend to pipeline", "SEO", "pricing", "SnapLogic", "more loan applications". Omit to return everything unfiltered.

name: vertodigital_get_value_proposition

differentiators.description: Matched reasons clients choose VertoDigital - present unless aspect narrows to another category

proof.description: The stat or fact backing this differentiator

proof_points.description: Matched flagship case-study proof points - present unless aspect narrows to another category

case_study_url.description: Full URL of the case study

stats.description: Headline results from the case study

services.description: Matched services - present unless aspect narrows to another category

pitch.description: One-paragraph description of how the service works

proof.description: Headline result and the client it came from

service_page.description: Path of the service page on vertodigital.com
